headline: Peru's State Oil Firm Petroperú Reports Q3 Profit Amid High Debt
summary: Petroperú returned to a profit of $24 million in the third quarter, though the state-owned oil company continues to carry $6.5 billion in debt and $45 million in cash.
why: State-owned energy enterprises are critical to national fiscal health and sovereign debt obligations in emerging economies, influencing sovereign bond yields.

impacts.name: Petróleos del Perú
impacts.why: The company posted a positive quarterly net profit despite substantial underlying debt obligations.
